shared_elements: possible bird-of-prey head with curved beak and rounded eye
raised-relief carving of creature forms on stone surface
justification: Both depict animal subjects and each arguably includes a raptor-like head with a hooked beak and a rounded eye rendered as a swelling boss, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence. Otherwise A is a flat, multi-register composition of many schematic profile creatures (row of caged animals, birds, scorpion-like and long-necked bird figures) organised in bands, whereas B is a single massive head or creature-fragment carved in bulging three-dimensional volumes with no narrative or registered arrangement at all.
